r01.

Premise correction + actual mechanism: Redis is not used. The cache layer is configured as an in-memory `cache.Cache` in `store/store.go`, where `userCache` is initialized with a 10-minute default TTL (`store/store.go:39-53`). User entries use that default via `s.userCache.Set(...)` (`store/user.go:92-99`), so their TTL is 10 minutes.
